auth.title: Staff sign-in
auth.mfa_subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.recovery_hint: No access to the app? Enter one of your recovery codes.
auth.mfa_invalid: The code did not work. Try again.
auth.mfa_expired: The time to enter the code has run out. Sign in again.
auth.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
auth.enrollment_required: No authenticator app is set up for this account. It is set up with a command on the server.
auth.generic: Could not sign in. Try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Business figures are available to the service owner and billing staff. Choose a section in the menu.

public_checks.hint: URL check history. Visitor IP and browser are retained for 90 days; public results and screenshots remain available for 5 minutes.

errors.step_up_failed: The confirmation code did not work.
errors.store_name_mismatch: The store name does not match.
errors.plan_code_invalid: Plan code: lowercase Latin letters, digits, “-” and “_”, 2 to 32 characters.
errors.plan_code_taken: A plan with this code exists.
errors.plan_name_missing: Fill in the name in all three languages before publishing.
errors.entitlement_limit_invalid: Check the limits: at least 1 store, checks at most every 5 minutes, history at least 1 day.
errors.price_interval_invalid: Period: every 1–365 days, weeks, months or years.
errors.price_exists: This version already has this price.
errors.price_already_at_provider: The price exists in Paddle and cannot be removed.
errors.version_not_draft: A published version cannot change — create a new one.
errors.version_not_published: The version is not on sale.
errors.draft_exists: The plan already has a draft.
errors.base_price_missing: Add a base price for the current payment mode.
errors.billing_not_configured: Paddle is not connected — publishing is not possible.
errors.provider_unavailable: Paddle did not answer. The version is still a draft; try again.
errors.discount_code_taken: A promo code with this code exists.
errors.discount_code_invalid_format: Promo code: 3–32 characters, Latin letters, digits, “-” and “_”.
errors.discount_amount_invalid: Discount: a percentage from 0.01 to 100 or an amount above zero.
errors.discount_duration_invalid: Duration: one payment, 1–1000 periods or forever.
errors.discount_usage_limit_invalid: The usage limit is a whole number above zero.
errors.discount_window_invalid: Check the dates: the end is after the start and in the future.
errors.discount_plan_unknown: One of the plans was not found.
errors.discount_name_invalid: Enter a discount name (up to 100 characters).
errors.discount_archived: The discount is archived and does not change.
errors.tenant_not_active: The organisation's service is already suspended.
errors.tenant_not_suspended: The organisation's service is not suspended.
errors.override_period_invalid: Temporary access lasts from now up to 180 days.
errors.override_active: The organisation already has active temporary access. Revoke it first.
errors.trial_not_running: The organisation has no trial of ours.
errors.trial_date_invalid: The new date must be later than the current one and at most 90 days ahead.
errors.no_active_subscription: There is no active paid subscription.
errors.provider_outcome_unknown: Paddle did not answer. Refresh later, do not repeat the action.
errors.slug_invalid: Address: lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 60 characters.
errors.too_deep: Pages can be nested one level only.
errors.no_draft: There is no draft to publish.
errors.system_page: A system page cannot be deleted.
errors.grace_days_invalid: The grace period is 0 to 365 days.
errors.faster_check_interval_invalid: The faster check interval is 5 to 1440 minutes and below the package interval; a faster-checks price cannot be published without it.
errors.faster_checks_unavailable: This package has no faster-checks add-on.
errors.policy_taken: Another page already has this document type.
errors.policy_type_invalid: Only an ordinary page can be a legal document.
errors.refund_exceeds_payment: The amount is more than can be refunded for this payment.
errors.refund_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
errors.name_invalid: Enter a name of up to 120 characters.
errors.category_invalid: Choose a group from the list.
errors.block_not_found: The template was not found or is already deleted.
errors.reminder_recently_sent: This reminder was just sent. It can be repeated in 10 minutes.
errors.no_recipients: The organisation has no active owner — there is nobody to email.
errors.plan_store_limit_reached: The customer plan does not allow more stores.
errors.already_member: This person is already in the organisation.
errors.role_not_assignable: This role cannot be given by invitation.
errors.reply_not_sent: The mail server refused the letter — the reply was neither sent nor stored. Try again later.
errors.reply_invalid: Enter a subject and the reply text.
errors.note_invalid: Write the note text (up to 2000 characters).
errors.period_invalid: The period must be 1 to 366 days, start before end.
errors.already_staff: This person is already a service staff member.
errors.self_change: You cannot change yourself — ask another owner.
errors.last_owner: The last service owner cannot be disabled or demoted.
errors.invitation_not_started: Start again: reload the page from the email link.
errors.mfa_code_invalid: The code did not match. Check the phone time and try again.
errors.maintenance_window_invalid: Check the times: end after start and in the future, at most 24 h, start at most 90 days ahead.
errors.maintenance_message_invalid: The message in every language needs 3 to 300 characters.
errors.version_is_legal: Versions of legal documents and versions customers accepted cannot be deleted.
errors.version_not_retired: Only an old, already replaced version can be deleted.
errors.media_type_unsupported: This file format is not allowed. The allowed formats are listed below the upload field.
errors.media_too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.media_dimensions_too_large: The image is too large — the allowed size is listed below the upload field.
errors.media_unreadable: The image could not be read — the file may be damaged.
errors.media_in_use: The image is still used on a page, in a draft, an old version or a block template — remove it there first.
errors.media_not_found: The image has already been deleted.
errors.media_too_large_for_server: The server does not have enough memory for such a large image — make it smaller and upload again.
errors.media_processing_unavailable: The server cannot process images of this format right now (a PHP module is missing). Tell the administrator.
errors.media_storage_unavailable: File storage is not available right now — try again later.
errors.owner_role_protected: The owner role only moves through an ownership transfer in the customer account.
errors.member_not_found: The member is no longer in the team.
errors.note_not_yours: You can only edit your own notes.
errors.owner_mfa_server_only: A platform owner's authenticator is reset only with the server command platform:reset-mfa.

feature.payment_attempts_script: Monitoring script on the payment page
feature.money_reconciliation: Money reconciliation with the payment provider

limit.max_extra_stores: Extra stores that can be bought
limit.min_check_interval_minutes: Checks at most every N minutes

plans.hint: Packages, their versions, prices and limits. A published version never changes: changes go into a new version and current customers stay on theirs.
plans.code_hint: Permanent, Latin letters: e.g. start, pro, agency-50.
plans.name: Name
plans.provider_missing: Paddle is not connected: drafts can be created, not published.
plans.published_note: This version is on sale and does not change. Subscribers on it: {n}. To change prices or limits, create a new version.
plans.retired_note: This version is retired. Its subscribers ({n}) keep their terms.
plans.trial_hint: 0 means no trial. The trial is ours, without a card.
plans.per_store: Per store: multiplied by the number of stores in the subscription
plans.limits_invalid: A limit is a whole non-negative number or “unlimited”.
plans.prices_hint: Prices are created for the current payment mode: {mode}.
plans.actions_hint: Publishing creates the product and prices in Paddle and shows the plan to customers. The previous version stops selling; its subscribers keep their terms.
plans.confirm_publish: Publish this version? Subscribers of the previous version are not moved.
plans.confirm_retire: Stop selling this version? New customers cannot buy it; subscribers ({n}) stay.
plans.grace_days: Grace period when over the volume, days
plans.grace_hint: How many days after the notice a store may run above the order limit while the customer chooses a package. Protection stays on and nothing extra is charged.
plans.contact_sales_hint: Shown on the website as “Individual” with a contact button; needs no prices and cannot be bought in the account.
plans.faster_hint: The faster-checks add-on: the customer can buy it with the package and checkout checks run at this interval. Set it below the package interval and add a price of the kind “Faster checks”. Empty — no add-on.

discounts.hint: Promo codes, discounts for specific customers and offers. Our server applies the discount at purchase and sends it to Paddle with the order.
discounts.name: Name (only you see it)
discounts.label: Text for the customer

audience_hint.code: the customer enters the code when buying
audience_hint.tenant: applied automatically for the chosen organisations
audience_hint.automatic: applied automatically for everyone buying the chosen plans

discounts.confirm_create: Create the discount? It appears in Paddle right away and applies on its terms.
discounts.confirm_archive: Archive “{name}”? New purchases do not get it; subscriptions that have it keep it until it ends.
discounts.confirm_edit: Change the limit and end of “{name}”?

history.hint: Every purchase and renewal: the amount before discounts, each discount in order (offer → personal → promo code) and the total sent to Paddle.
history.failed: Paddle returned {code}; the scheduler will retry.

tenants.hint: Customer organisations. Access state and payment state are shown separately. Store details (findings, orders, screenshots) are not shown here.
tenants.search_hint: Name, organisation ID or the owner's verified email

subscriptions.hint: Each organisation's current subscription: plan, payment state, access and next charge.

tenant.pilot: Pilot mode: plan limits are not enforced.
tenant.stores_hint: Summary only. Store findings, orders and screenshots open only with a support grant.

sub.cancel_scheduled: Cancellation scheduled: the subscription ends on {date}.

tenant.audit_empty: No staff actions on this organisation yet.

actions.title: Actions
actions.hint: Review the consequences first, then give a reason and the authenticator code. Everything is audited.

explain.suspend: Checks, notifications and features stop. The subscription and its charges are not cancelled — that is a separate action.
explain.resume: Lifts the manual pause. Access is calculated from payment and plan again; nothing is marked as paid.
explain.grant_override: Access of the chosen plan for a limited time (up to 180 days). With a paid subscription the features are combined and each limit takes the more generous value. Does not change the subscription and is not revenue.
explain.revoke_override: Temporary access ends now; access follows the subscription again.
explain.extend_trial: Only our own trial without payment; the new date is later than the current one and at most 90 days ahead.
explain.cancel_subscription: Renewal stops at Paddle; access stays until the paid period ends, nothing is refunded.
explain.refresh_billing: Reads the organisation's subscriptions from Paddle again. Changes nothing at the provider.

effective.cancel_subscription: Renewal stops now; paid access lasts until {date}

done.cancel_subscription: Subscription cancelled. Access remains until the paid period ends.

reminder.title: Reminder to the customer
reminder.hint: Choose the recipients among the organisation's members and edit the letter if needed. “Save as template” keeps the text for every organisation; “Send” sends the letter. Every sent letter is kept in the Reminders tab.
reminder.subject: Subject
reminder.no_recipients: The organisation has no members — there is nobody to write to.
reminder.placeholders: Subject and text may use {list} — they are replaced by the organisation's name and the link to its subscription page.

team.hint: The invitation goes to the address on behalf of the Business Watchdog team; the person joins the organisation with the link in the email — as with an invitation from the account. The reason is recorded in the audit.
team.mfa_reset_warning: All user sessions will end and recovery codes will stop working. The user will receive an email. Confirm with your authenticator code.
team.mfa_reset_done: The user's MFA was reset. A notification was sent.
team.role_hint: The new role applies at once. The owner role only moves through an ownership transfer in the customer account.
team.remove_warning: The member loses access to the organisation; their account stays.

reminders.hint: Every sent reminder: who, when, to whom and with which text.

deletion.open: Delete the organization at the customer's request…
deletion.warning: The organization “{name}” stops being served at once, a paid Paddle subscription is cancelled without a refund, and after 30 days the data is deleted for good. Only on the customer's written request; the organization owners get an email.
deletion.scheduled: The organization will be deleted on {date}

by.owner: The organization owner requested the deletion on {date}.
by.platform: The platform owner requested the deletion at the customer's request on {date}.

deletion.cancel_hint: Cancelling restores the service; the cancelled subscription does not come back. The organization owners get an email.
deletion.running: The deletion is already running and cannot be cancelled.
deletion.failed: The deletion stopped after several errors — it needs help on the server (docs/ops/maintenance.md, privacy:process-deletions).

staff.mfa_reenrolled: Staff member connected a new authenticator

site.hint: Pages of the public website. Every page has its own address and a separate text per language: draft → preview → publish. Published versions never change and stay in the history.

system_hint.home: Home page of the site. The editor holds its current text; until you publish your own version, the site shows the built-in text.
system_hint.pricing: Plan cards and prices come from “Plans and discounts”.
system_hint.contact: Messages from the form go to “Messages”.

create.title: New page
create.hint: The address is set once and never changes. Two levels at most, e.g. legal/terms.
create.slug_rules: Lowercase latin letters, digits and single hyphens only, up to 60 characters.

field.title: Title
field.description_hint: Up to 300 characters; shown in search results.
field.body_hint: The page title is shown automatically — start with text or a subheading (Heading 2).
field.body_hint_system: If you empty the field, the site keeps the built-in home text.

help.title: What you can use in the HTML
help.allowed: Ordinary markup: headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images over https, tables, quotes. Scripts, iframes, forms, event handlers (onclick…) and the style attribute are removed on save.

site.unsaved_switch: Unsaved changes will be lost. Switch the language?
site.save_first: Save the draft first, then publish.

confirm.publish: Publish the draft ({locale}) at {path}? The current version moves to the history.
confirm.unpublish: Unpublish {path}? Visitors will see “page not found”.
confirm.archive: Delete the page in all languages? Published versions stay in the history and the address becomes free.
confirm.delete_version: The old version {version} will be deleted for good. The published version and the draft are not affected.

done.restored: The version was copied to the draft — check it and publish.

site.slug_fixed: The page address was set at creation and does not change.

policy.label: Legal document
policy.hint: Customers accept the published version of this page: at sign-up the terms of service and privacy notice, at trial, purchase and plan change the terms of service and subscription terms. Each type belongs to one page. A new publication is a new version: customers accept it at their next action.

site.in_code: The text of this page is changed only in the site code. Here you set which menu shows it and in what order.

mode.label: Editing mode
mode.html_hint: Markup the visual editor does not know may be simplified when you switch back. Check the preview.

contacts.hint: Messages from the contact form of the website. New messages are announced by email. Closed messages are deleted after a year.
contacts.retention: A closed message is deleted 365 days after it was closed.

replies.title: Replies
replies.subject: Subject
replies.frame: A greeting to “{name}”, the team signature and the original message are added automatically; the letter language is {locale}.

payments.hint: Customer payments for our subscription (from Paddle). Amounts are in the payment currency; different currencies are never added up.
payments.after_paddle: Left after tax and Paddle fees
payments.net_hint: Based on confirmed payments and refunds this month. If Paddle has not supplied tax or fees, the amount after them is unknown. Refund fee adjustments and other business costs are excluded, so this is not accounting profit.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.hint: The refund is sent to Paddle after platform owner approval. A full refund ends the subscription and access; a partial refund leaves the plan intact.
refunds.approve_hint: Refund {amount} to the customer through Paddle?
refunds.partial_effect: A partial refund does not change the subscription or plan.
refunds.full_effect: Once the full refund is approved, the subscription and plan access end immediately.
refunds.reason: Reason (shown in the audit and Paddle)
refunds.cancel_subscription: A full refund immediately ends the subscription and plan access
refunds.form_hint: The request appears under «Refunds»; money goes out after the owner approves.
refunds.owner_hint: The code submits the refund to Paddle. If Paddle reviews it, the money is returned after approval.
refunds.sent_done: Refund sent to Paddle. If Paddle reviews it, the status updates after approval.
refunds.requested_done: The refund request was created and awaits approval.

editor.heading: Heading {level}
editor.link_hint: A site page, e.g. /en/pricing; an external address starts with https://. An empty address removes the link.
editor.insert_block_hint: A ready block is inserted after the block with the cursor. Replace its text and links with your own.

media.delete_confirm: Delete the image “{name}” from the library? This is only possible when no page, draft, version or block template uses it.
media.hint_images: Images at most {side} px per side and {megapixels} MP; metadata (camera, location) is removed.
media.hint_resize: Images longer than {side} px are made smaller.
media.hint_pdf: A PDF is stored as it is and inserted as a link — make sure it contains nothing private.

blocks.hint: Ready blocks inserted into site pages from the visual editor with “+ Block”. Changing a template does not change pages it was already inserted into.
blocks.languages_hint: Fill the template for every site language. If a language is missing, a page in that language gets the first filled one.
blocks.archive_confirm: The template disappears from the page editor. Pages it was already inserted into do not change.
blocks.unsaved_leave: Unsaved changes will be lost. Leave the page?

store_data.hint: Read only — what the customer sees in the account, within the retention of their plan. Opening a store is recorded in the audit.

skip_reason.payment_methods_not_verified: Payment methods not verified: the check does not load payment gateway scripts (Stripe, PayPal, etc.) and the store's payment form waits for them. The path up to the payment form is confirmed.
skip_reason.synthetic_location_not_configured: No delivery address is set for the check — delivery was not checked.

add.title: Add a store for the customer
add.hint: The store appears in the customer account; the same rules and plan limit apply. The customer connects the plugin themselves.
add.name: Name

remove.warning: Permanently delete “{name}” and its orders, payments, findings, checks and screenshots? This cannot be undone. Platform audit and the trial-domain hash remain. Remove the plugin or App from the shop separately.
remove.name: Enter the exact store name

incident_title.MONEY_CAPTURE_MISSING: Order marked as paid, no capture found at the provider
incident_title.MONEY_CAPTURE_AMOUNT: Captured amount differs from the order total
incident_title.MONEY_CAPTURE_NOT_RECORDED: Payment captured, but order not marked as paid
incident_title.MONEY_REFUND_MISSING: Refund in the store, not found at the provider
incident_title.MONEY_REFUND_EXTRA: Refund at the provider that the store does not show
incident_title.MONEY_MULTIPLE_CAPTURES: Several different captures for one order
incident_title.MONEY_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Capture currency differs from the order currency
incident_title.MONEY_PAYMENT_WITHOUT_ORDER: Provider payment not matched to an order
incident_title.MONEY_PAYMENT_NOT_MATCHED: Order marked paid, no provider payment found for its reference
incident_title.MONEY_CANCELLED_PAID: Order cancelled, but the money was not refunded
incident_title.MONEY_PAYMENT_FAILED_ORDER_OPEN: Payment failed, but the order is not cancelled
incident_title.CHECKOUT_FLOW_FAILED: The check did not reach the payment form
incident_title.CHECKOUT_TEST_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: The test product for checks is unavailable
incident_title.CHECKOUT_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED: This site's checkout is not supported by the check yet
incident_title.INTEGRATION_STALE: The store plugin is not reporting
incident_title.INTEGRATION_DELIVERY_DELAYED: The store plugin is sending data late
incident_title.CHECKOUT_TEST_ACCOUNT_REJECTED: The shop does not accept the test customer sign-in
incident_title.CHECKOUT_SUBMIT_FAILING: Customers submit the order, but no order is created

check_error.site_failure: The site did not let the check reach the payment form.
check_error.worker_capacity: Not enough free browsers on our side.
check_error.dns_failure: The store domain could not be found.
check_error.selector_changed: A page element was not found: the site theme may have changed.
check_error.adapter_unsupported: The site's checkout is not supported by the check.
check_error.forbidden_mutation: The page tried a forbidden action; the check stopped.
check_error.blocked_external_origin: The page called an address the check does not allow.
check_error.infra_timeout: The check ran out of time because of a failure on our side.
check_error.lease_expired: The browser stopped responding; the attempt was interrupted.
check_error.test_account_rejected: The shop did not accept the test customer sign-in.

support.rerun: Rerun the check for the customer

confirm.rerun: The check starts now. The customer's manual-run allowance is not used; their log shows that support started it.
confirm.acknowledge: The incident is marked as acknowledged by support.
confirm.resolve: The incident is resolved with this reason; the customer's log shows that support resolved it.

overview.hint: Commercial figures by the specification definitions: every currency separately, LIVE and TEST never mixed. Click a figure to open the list it is counted from.
overview.utc: Dates in UTC, both days included.
overview.no_data: There is no subscription data in {mode} — the figures are incomplete, this is not zero revenue.

mrr.title: Contracted MRR
mrr.definition: Fixed recurring list prices of active paid subscriptions (plan + extra stores + faster checks), without tax and before discounts; a yearly price counts 1/12 per month. Trials, free access and one-off charges are excluded. This is not money received.
mrr.unpriced: no price in the catalog: {n} (not counted)

money.title: Money in the period
money.definition: Collected — successful payments of our invoices (incl. tax) by invoice date; refunds — confirmed by Paddle; net — the difference, may be negative. Not payouts and not profit.
money.none: No money moved in the period.
money.previous: Net in the previous equal period

churn.title: Paid churn
churn.counts: ended: {ended} of {start} running at the start of the period

later.title: Later
later.body: Trial conversion — the cohort window needs approval; costs and margin — once real costs are recorded.

service.hint: Service summary: components, queues and their delays, browser checks, connector sync, version. Aggregates only, no customer data. Refreshed every minute.
service.forbidden: This section is available to the service owner and administrators.

queues.title: Queues
queues.hint: Age is how long the oldest entry has been waiting. Longer than {warn} — attention, longer than {crit} — problem; dead entries also need attention.
queues.name: Queue
queues.jobs_unavailable: The queue does not answer: the number of jobs is unknown.

about.event_inbox: received from connectors and not processed yet; problems are quarantined or dropped
about.domain_outbox: problems have run out of attempts
about.billing_events: webhooks and event polling; problems are quarantined or dropped
about.reconciliation: orders waiting to be re-checked; age is how overdue
about.notifications: emails and messages queued; problems were not delivered in the last day
about.jobs: connector sync jobs taken by the workers (queue:work); problems failed in the last day

sync.title: Connector sync
sync.counts: active connections: {active}, without a successful sync for more than {hours} h: {stale}

service.later: Maintenance windows and worker limits will be configured later in «Settings».

staff.hint: Platform staff and their permissions: an owner can do everything, for everyone else you tick what they may do. An invitation is valid for 72 hours; the new member sets a password and connects an authenticator app. Changing access and disabling need a code from the app; you cannot change yourself or the last owner.
staff.forbidden: This section is available to the service owner.
staff.invite_hint: An email with a link goes to the address. A platform owner gets full access; for a staff member tick what they may do.
staff.mfa_reset: A staff member's authenticator is reset here: they get a link to connect a new one. A platform owner's authenticator only with the server command platform:reset-mfa (see README, Maintenance).

confirm.role: The new access applies at once and all sessions of the member end.
confirm.disable: The member can no longer sign in; all their sessions end.
confirm.enable: The member can sign in again.
confirm.sessions: All sessions of the member end; they need to sign in again.
confirm.revoke-invitation: The link in the email stops working.
confirm.mfa: The old authenticator stops working and all the member's sessions end; a link to connect a new one goes to their address (valid for 72 hours).

staff.owner_all: Everything, including staff and refund approval.

staff_join.title: Invitation to the team
staff_join.offer: Address {email}, role «{role}». The link is valid until {date}.
staff_join.invalid: The invitation was not found, is already used, revoked or expired. Ask the service owner for a new one.
staff_join.existing: This address already has an account — enter its password.
staff_join.name: Your name
staff_join.mfa_setup: Scan the QR code in your app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, …) or type the key, then enter the code from the app.
staff_join.mfa_existing: The account already has an authenticator — enter its code.
staff_join.done_title: Done, you are in the team
staff_join.recovery: Save the recovery codes — they are shown once and needed if the app is unavailable:
staff_join.reset_offer: Address {email}. Enter your password and connect a new authenticator app. The link is valid until {date}.
staff_join.reset_done_title: Done, the new authenticator is connected

audit.hint: Log of actions by service staff and the system: who, what, on which object, result and reason. Changes are kept without secrets or personal data.
audit.forbidden: This section is available to the service owner and administrators.

settings.hint: Maintenance window for customers and the service configuration. Secrets are never shown — only whether a key is set and a short fingerprint; they are changed on the server.
settings.forbidden: This section is available to the service owner.

maintenance.title: Planned maintenance
maintenance.hint: All customers see the message in their account from publishing until the end. At most {hours} h long and at most {days} days ahead; a new version replaces the current one. Needs a reason and the app code.

config.title: Configuration
config.hint: Read only. Values come from the server environment (README, «Release»).
config.retention_value: screenshots {screenshots_days} days, exports {exports_days} days, messages {contact_days} days after closing, platform audit {platform_audit_days} days
config.site_value: message notification recipients: {contact_notify}, page cache {cache_seconds} s
config.site_value_owners: message notifications go to every service owner, page cache {cache_seconds} s

settings.later: Browser check worker limits are set only in the server environment for now.

tenants_read.label: Customers: view
tenants_read.hint: Company cards, stores, their data and teams.

tenants_manage.label: Customers: change
tenants_manage.hint: Pause, trial extension, temporary access, reminders, customer team.

customers_mfa_reset.label: Customers: MFA reset
customers_mfa_reset.hint: Turn off a customer user's authenticator (with a reason and a code).

tenants_support.label: Customers: temporary support access
tenants_support.hint: Request a customer-approved grant for store diagnostics, materials or a browser recheck.

tenants_incident_actions.label: Customers: incident actions
tenants_incident_actions.hint: Acknowledge or resolve an incident for a customer with a reason, audit and customer notification.

tenants_delete.label: Customers: delete an organization
tenants_delete.hint: Delete an organization on the customer's written request, or cancel that within 30 days.

billing_read.label: Billing: view
billing_read.hint: Overview, subscriptions, payments, invoices and refunds.

refunds_request.label: Refunds: request
refunds_request.hint: Request a refund of a payment; a platform owner approves it.

refunds_approve.label: Refunds: approve
refunds_approve.hint: Send a requested refund to Paddle.

plans_manage.label: Plans: change
